results.name: A Witches Odyssey Wiki
results.description: This world is teeming with magic. Different species and creatures roam the earth in all shapes and sizes. Infinite realms await exploration, and countless people to meet. Magic flows through every living thing, cultivating and growing in places like the Belmont Witch Institute, named after the legendary Headmaster Belmont. He was the first witch to discover the reform spell and master the elusive third stage of magic. Though it has been many years since anyone has seen him, the school still stands proudly at the center of Winterwood.  Belmont Witch Institute, or B.W.I., is highly prestigious and only accepts 64 students every four years. But once you’re in, your life will never be the same. B.W.I. is composed of four units, each fostering a unique aspect of magical mastery.

results.name: Roald Dahl Wiki
results.description: Roald Dahl was a British novelist, short story writer, poet, fighter pilot and screenwriter. Born in Wales, to Norwegian parents, he served in the Royal Air Force during World War II, in which he became a flying ace and intelligence officer, rising to the rank of wing commander. Dahl rose to prominence in the 1940s, with works for both children and adults, and became one of the world's best-selling authors. He has been referred to as "one of the greatest storytellers for children of the 20th century"

Its second season follow another group of supernatural teens, Ella (witch), Leah (vampire) & Ava (banshee), who deal with the impending doom of the witch hunters coming to

results.name: The Salem Wiki
results.description:
The Salem wiki is a collaborative encyclopaedia source dedicate to covering the WGN America series Salem. 

Set in the volatile world of 17th century Massachusetts, 'Salem' explores what really fueled the town's infamous witch trials and dares to uncover the dark, supernatural truth hiding behind the veil of this infamous period in American history. In Salem, witches are real, but they are not who or what they seem.

results.name: Family or Love Wiki
results.description: Ghouls, a powerful and despised creature, seen as a scourge on this earth, even to the other who are magical like them. Vampires see them as a disgrace, Werewolves see them as animals, and Witches see them as a true abomination, something that needs to be purged. The first Ghoul, and one of the last hundred, wants to save his kind, but forms an unlikely relationship with a Witch. However, he battled within himself to hide the truth about himself, or risk losing his relationship by being truthful. He loves his relationship, but he also wants to save his kind, so he's forced to juggle his "normal life" with saving his kind.

The show spotlights on the journey and friendship of the Wicked Witch of the West and Good Witch of the North. According to Broadway.com, Wicked shifts from being the first or second most grossing in New York and is first in West End. 

This wikia is an in-depth encyclopedia on all things Wicked. We would greatly appreciate any contributions, as long as the information is as accurate as possible.

Ojamajo Doremi (おジャ魔女どれみ Ojamajo Doremi?, lit: Troublesome Witch Doremi), known as Magical DoReMi in America, is a magical girl anime television series created by Toei Animation in 1999. results.name: Thesabrinatheteenagewitch Wiki
results.description:
This wiki is a complete and reliable encyclopedia that collects all information from the 1996-2003 TV sitcom, Sabrina the Teenage Witch starring Melissa Joan Hart! 

The wiki consists of information ONLY from the sitcom and its two TV movies generally, which means that it is not intended to hold major information from the original Archie Comic Book series, the original 1960s cartoon, the Pilot Movie, or Sabrina: the Animated Series but information from these aforementioned Sabrina adaptations can be posted as trivia on the wiki, if they're relevant facts.
